# Sky Sports
> Sky Sports is a UK sports media platform for live sport, breaking news, scores, transfers, analysis, and video across major sports.

Sky Sports covers football, Formula 1, cricket, rugby, golf, boxing, tennis, racing, American sports, and more. The site combines sport-specific news hubs with live scores, fixtures, results, standings, features, and video coverage.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.skysports.com): Main entry point for top stories, breaking news, live sport, and featured coverage.
- [Watch Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/watch): Hub for watching live sport, schedules, channels, and streaming information.
- [Live Scores](https://www.skysports.com/live-scores): Real-time scores, fixtures, and results across multiple sports and competitions.
- [Get Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/get-sky-sports): Subscription and access information for Sky Sports channels and streaming.
- [Video](https://www.skysports.com/watch/video): Video hub for highlights, interviews, clips, and analysis across sports.

## Football
- [Football](https://www.skysports.com/football): Main football hub for news, live scores, fixtures, tables, and match reports.
- [Premier League](https://www.skysports.com/premier-league): Coverage of Premier League news, fixtures, results, standings, and analysis.
- [Transfer Centre](https://www.skysports.com/transfer-centre): Football transfer news, rumours, confirmed deals, and deadline day updates.
- [Champions League](https://www.skysports.com/champions-league): UEFA Champions League news, fixtures, results, and match coverage.
- [Scottish Football](https://www.skysports.com/scottish-football): News and results from the Scottish Premiership and domestic cups.
- [Women's Football](https://www.skysports.com/football/womens-football): Coverage of women's leagues, tournaments, players, and international matches.
- [Football Videos](https://www.skysports.com/watch/football): Football highlights, interviews, goals, and analysis clips.

## Formula 1 and Motorsport
- [F1](https://www.skysports.com/f1): Formula 1 news, race weekends, standings, driver updates, and analysis.
- [F1 Schedule & Results](https://www.skysports.com/f1/schedule-results): Formula 1 calendar, race times, qualifying, and results.
- [F1 Standings](https://www.skysports.com/f1/standings): Current driver and constructor championship standings.
- [Racing](https://www.skysports.com/racing): Horse racing news, racecards, results, tips, and event coverage.
- [Racing Results](https://www.skysports.com/racing/results): Horse racing results from UK and international meetings.
- [Racing Cards](https://www.skysports.com/racing/racecards): Daily racecards, runners, riders, and meeting details.

## Cricket and Rugby
- [Cricket](https://www.skysports.com/cricket): Cricket news, live scores, series coverage, fixtures, and results.
- [Cricket Fixtures](https://www.skysports.com/cricket/fixtures): Upcoming cricket matches, series schedules, and start times.
- [Cricket Results](https://www.skysports.com/cricket/results): Recent cricket results across domestic and international competitions.
- [Rugby Union](https://www.skysports.com/rugby-union): Rugby union news, fixtures, results, and tournament coverage.
- [Rugby League](https://www.skysports.com/rugby-league): Rugby league news, Super League coverage, fixtures, and results.
- [Rugby Union Fixtures](https://www.skysports.com/rugby-union/fixtures): Upcoming rugby union matches and competition schedules.
- [Rugby League Fixtures](https://www.skysports.com/rugby-league/fixtures): Upcoming rugby league fixtures and match listings.

## Golf and Tennis
- [Golf](https://www.skysports.com/golf): Golf news, tournament coverage, leaderboards, and player features.
- [Golf Leaderboards](https://www.skysports.com/golf/leaderboard): Live and completed golf tournament leaderboards.
- [Golf Schedule](https://www.skysports.com/golf/schedule-results): Golf tournament schedule, tee times, and results.
- [Tennis](https://www.skysports.com/tennis): Tennis news, tournament coverage, results, and player updates.
- [Tennis Schedule](https://www.skysports.com/tennis/schedule-results): Tennis fixtures, draws, and tournament results.
- [Tennis Videos](https://www.skysports.com/watch/tennis): Tennis highlights, interviews, and match clips.

## Boxing, MMA, and Darts

- [MMA](https://www.skysports.com/mma): Mixed martial arts news, fight coverage, and results.
- [MMA Schedule](https://www.skysports.com/mma/schedule-results): Upcoming MMA events and completed fight results.

## News, Scores, and Results
- [News](https://www.skysports.com/news): Latest sports news stories across all covered competitions and events.
- [Live Scores](https://www.skysports.com/live-scores): In-progress scores and match status across sports.
- [Football Scores](https://www.skysports.com/football/live-scores): Live football scores from domestic and international competitions.
- [Football Fixtures](https://www.skysports.com/football/fixtures-results): Football fixtures, results, and match listings.
- [F1 Schedule & Results](https://www.skysports.com/f1/schedule-results): Formula 1 race calendar and completed weekend results.
